verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets users build custom flows that automate team processes and 'define triggers to control when the flow runs'. External agents can also be triggered directly from discussions, issues, or merge requests, so event-driven automation is a first-party capability. The evidence is thin, though: one-line doc mentions with no detail on trigger types or rule conditions. Missing for 10: documented catalog of supported trigger events, rule/condition syntax depth, native outbound event hooks evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
